recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body monochrome portrait of a subject seated on a tall stool, framed by a thin white inner border against a black outer margin. The background is a textured, mottled studio backdrop with heavy vignetting that focuses light on the subject's torso and face.
coreVisualRelationships: Text aligned to the top corners within the frame
High contrast between white jacket and dark trousers/background
Thin white border containing the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space, seated on a stool.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and light-colored jacket serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the vertical line of the stool, then outward to the text in the top corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space on the left and right sides creates a sense of intimacy and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the outer frame and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the textured background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and thin border line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject's jacket and the surrounding darkness.

composition.position: Top left and top right corners
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in negative space at the top of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both name and title to maintain minimalist symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric roots and clean uppercase appearance.
Classic proportions that work well with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A black and white studio portrait of a person sitting on a stool, centered. The background should be a mottled gray textured wall with heavy vignetting. The subject should wear a light-colored denim jacket. Frame the entire image with a thin white line and a black outer margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white at the top left and top right corners. Use extremely wide tracking so the letters breathe across the top margin.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel airy?
Is the white border line thin and perfectly rectangular?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Unique pins or badges on the jacket
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeds into the grayscale
Check that the white border is not broken
Verify text is aligned to the top corners
Confirm the background texture looks like a studio backdrop
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Subject + Mottled Vignette + Thin White Frame + Wide-Tracked Corner Sans-Serif = Classic 80s Portrait Aesthetic
